verified_metadata.title: Machine learning active-nematic hydrodynamics
verified_metadata.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
verified_metadata.abstract: Neural networks trained on active-nematic simulations infer activity and elasticity from director movies and forecast experimental dynamics in latent space.
verified_metadata.comment: PNAS article with arXiv manuscript and public Zenodo code

sections.title: 作者信息
paragraphs: 作者 Jonathan Colen、Ming Han、Rui Zhang 等；PNAS 118, e2016708118 (2021)，DOI:10.1073/pnas.2016708118。核验 arXiv:2006.13203 全文16页及代码/数据声明。

sections.title: 研究问题
paragraphs: active nematic的activity α、elastic constant K等宏观参数难从microscopic motor chemistry推导，velocity也常不可直接测。能否仅由director-field movies估计这些参数的时空变化，并在不显式求解方程时预测chaotic field的短期未来？

sections.title: 背景
paragraphs: active stress σ^a_ij=α n_i n_j与Frank elasticity竞争，决定defect density和correlation length。实验为microtubule–kinesin及actin–myosin systems，ATP或light控制motor activity。
参数估计网络先用lattice-Boltzmann synthetic data监督训练，再迁移到实验；forecast网络则可直接用实验序列训练。两任务的数据依赖和物理先验不同。

sections.title: 模型与方法
paragraphs: 参数网络含convolution、LSTM和dense layers，以nematic-symmetry representation输入多个frames，输出α、K等；大图按patch预测并ensemble。训练library扫描2D/3D simulation parameters。
forecast使用autoencoder压缩director image，recurrent residual model在latent space逐步预测，再decode；为抑制chaos误差累积，周期性把真实frame重新初始化，并与machine-learning-informed LB比较。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
paragraphs: Figure 1显示2D/3D director输入、network和activity recovery；simulation test中预测α/K接近truth。Figure 3把microtubule–kinesin实验的ATP变化映射为α上升、K下降，并让ML-calibrated LB的correlation length与defect density匹配实验。
Figure 3还展示light-activated spatially heterogeneous activity：网络重建illumination region内外α/K fields。forecast部分在短期比未校准simulation更接近实验，但长期仍受chaotic divergence限制。
实验参数并无独立ground-truth meter；其可信度来自simulation-trained inverse mapping、趋势一致性和ML+LB统计回放，而非直接测量α、K。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
paragraphs: simulation-to-experiment存在domain gap；training continuum model、one-constant approximation、imaging noise和director extraction都会影响参数。α与K可存在组合identifiability，单个movie未必唯一分离。
forecast以短期图像误差为主，周期性truth reset不等于长期free-running prediction。样本来自少数active-nematic platforms，control仅被提出，未执行闭环实验。

sections.title: 复现与资源
paragraphs: 复现需固定director extraction、pixel scale、simulation α/K ranges、patching、CNN/LSTM architecture、dropout、ATP/light protocols与forecast reset interval。Evidence status: full-text verified theory/simulation/experiment study; no independent reproduction performed.

sections.title: 阅读指南
paragraphs: 先读 pp.1–3 Figure 1参数网络；pp.4–6看ATP/light experiments和Figure 3；pp.6–9读forecast；pp.10–16为methods、额外实验与参考文献。
